decisions.evidence: The training recipe emphasizes domain vocabulary and instruction adherence rather than external tools, so the final system can be evaluated as a standalone Medical QA model.
Yet rare conditions still trigger hallucinated details, and the 70B footprint makes deployment expensive.
Future systems should combine domain expertise with lighter evidence mechanisms.
